flags: Makefile BENCH_CFLAGS: -O3 -march=native C11 warnings -Werror; no sanitizers or LTO in timed builds
policy: Existing defaults unchanged; no affinity overrides; alternating AB/BA pairs; synthetic inputs; 128-frame pipeline warmup; standalone benchmark is not a VLC presentation measurement

pipeline.source: eight synthetic smooth I420 inputs at half output dimensions
pipeline.frame_hash: final frame only; separate exhaustive arithmetic and oracle tests cover correctness

capture_order: Alternating AB/BA; sequential benchmark processes. Final timing series started after builds and tests completed.
limitations: One Linux Zen 4 host; ISA comparisons use this same CPU.
No CPU isolation or temperature stabilization; boost and desktop scheduling can vary.
Descriptive medians and paired ratios; no universal no-regression guarantee.
Standalone non-LTO processing harness; not a VLC presentation measurement.
reproduce_pipeline: make build-profile EXTRA_CFLAGS=-Werror; build/profile_pipeline 12 USM_WORKERS WIDTH HEIGHT FRAMES 0 0 1 PERIOD_US
reproduce_kernel: gcc -O3 -g -march=ISA -std=c11 -D_GNU_SOURCE -Wall -Wextra -Wshadow -Wpointer-arith -Wstrict-prototypes -Werror tests/bench_usm_pool.c src/usm_pool.c -lpthread -o bench; ./bench WORKERS WIDTH HEIGHT 800 20 rand in

kernel_final_protocol.screen: Three alternating pairs of 400 frames per ISA/geometry/worker cell; one worker and automatic counts 8/12/16.
kernel_final_protocol.fallback_confirmation: Twenty alternating pairs of 1200 frames, SSE2 3840x2160 with 16 workers, to investigate +5.02% in the three-pair screen.

isa_anchor_relocation: Final inspection marker moved from callback to kernel to retain the existing linked ISA regression. Single-version benchmark .text sections remain byte-identical at all three ISA levels, as does the native pipeline profiler; see anchor-text-comparison.json.
reproduce_prototypes: Apply the named zero-context patch to the recorded baseline source using patch -p1, or git apply --unidiff-zero, in an isolated copy.
